 Fans protest after failing to secure tickets for NPL final match
 Deshsanchar 
 November 20, 2026 
 A 
 + 
 A 
 A 
 - 
 Kathmandu – Disappointed fans gathered at the Tribhuvan University Cricket Ground after failing to secure tickets for the Nepal Premier League (NPL) final match scheduled for Saturday.
 They protested against the organizers, the Cricket Association of Nepal (CAN). Tickets for the match between Lumbini Lions and Sudurpaschim Royals were sold out shortly after sales opened. Many fans were unable to get tickets as there was a rush to purchase them simultaneously.
 CAN has urged fans who could not get tickets to watch the match online, as all tickets corresponding to the stadium’s capacity have been sold.
